games.description: The grim darkness of the far future. 10th edition rules companion.

games.name: Age of Sigmar

warhammer-40k.name: Command Phase
warhammer-40k.description: At the start of your turn you gain 1 Command Point. Units below half-strength must take Battle-shock tests. This is when you use Command abilities and many Stratagems.
keyActions: Take Battle-shock tests for units below half-strength

warhammer-40k.name: Movement Phase
warhammer-40k.description: Move your units across the battlefield. Each unit can make a Normal Move, Advance, or Remain Stationary. Reinforcements arrive and units may embark or disembark from transports.
keyActions: Make Normal Moves, Advances, or Remain Stationary
Set up reinforcement units arriving from reserves

warhammer-40k.name: Shooting Phase
warhammer-40k.description: Select eligible units with ranged weapons, choose targets, and resolve attacks. Make hit rolls, wound rolls, saving throws, and allocate damage.
keyActions: Select units with ranged weapons to shoot
Choose valid targets and resolve ranged attacks
Apply weapon abilities such as Rapid Fire and Blast
relevantKeywords: CHAMPION OF THE ORDER OF PURIFIERS

warhammer-40k.name: Charge Phase
warhammer-40k.description: Declare charge moves with eligible units. Roll 2D6 for charge distance; the unit must end within Engagement Range of every target. Characters may perform Heroic Interventions.
keyActions: Declare charges and choose charge targets
Roll 2D6 and make the charge move into Engagement Range

warhammer-40k.name: Fight Phase
warhammer-40k.description: Units within Engagement Range fight. Players alternate selecting units to fight, starting with the player whose turn it is not. Units Pile In, make attacks, and Consolidate.
keyActions: Fight with units in Engagement Range, alternating between players
Pile In before attacking and Consolidate afterwards

drukhari.briefAbility: Baleblast: ranged attacks from this unit deal mortal wounds on unmodified wound rolls of 4+.

drukhari.name: Ravager
drukhari.briefAbility: Night Shields: this model's saving throw against ranged attacks is improved by 1 (e.g. 5+ becomes 4+).

drukhari.name: Raider
drukhari.briefAbility: Open-topped: units embarked on this transport can fire their own weapons as if they were not embarked.

genestealer-cults.name: Neophyte Hybrids
genestealer-cults.briefAbility: Cult Ambush: at the start of the game, this unit can be set up in ambush markers anywhere on the battlefield and is revealed at the start of a later turn.

genestealer-cults.name: Acolyte Hybrids
genestealer-cults.briefAbility: Return to the Shadows: once per battle, this unit can be removed from the battlefield at the end of a phase and redeployed via Cult Ambush in a subsequent turn.

genestealer-cults.name: Aberrants
genestealer-cults.briefAbility: Hyper-ferocity: this unit may re-roll Charge rolls; on a successful charge, each model in the unit makes D3 additional melee attacks.

genestealer-cults.name: Patriarch
genestealer-cults.briefAbility: Genestealer Familiar: can perform a psychic action to grant a friendly unit within 6" an Advance and then Charge action in the same turn.

genestealer-cults.name: Magus
genestealer-cults.briefAbility: Psychic Backlash: once per Psychic Phase, when an enemy Psyker fails an action near this model, deal D3 mortal wounds to that unit.

genestealer-cults.name: Goliath Truck
genestealer-cults.briefAbility: Industrial Camouflage: this vehicle gains the benefit of Light Cover unless it Advanced or charged this turn.

genestealer-cults.name: Cults Leman Russ
genestealer-cults.briefAbility: Grinding Advance: does not suffer the penalty for moving and shooting Heavy weapons; can choose to fire its main weapon twice if it Remains Stationary.

leagues-of-votann.name: Hearthkyn Warriors
leagues-of-votann.briefAbility: Oaths of Kinship: choose an enemy unit at the start of the battle; all friendly Kin units re-roll Wound rolls of 1 against that unit for the entire game.

leagues-of-votann.name: Kahl
leagues-of-votann.briefAbility: Warlord: once per Command Phase, the Kahl can issue an Order granting the led unit re-rolls to hit and wound against the unit designated by Oaths of Kinship.

leagues-of-votann.name: Einhyr Hearthguard
leagues-of-votann.briefAbility: Exo-armour Hearthguard: 2+ armour save and a 4+ invulnerable save; their melee weapons have Devastating Wounds.

leagues-of-votann.name: Cthonian Berserks
leagues-of-votann.briefAbility: Berserk Fury: melee attacks by this unit gain Lethal Hits when charging; this unit re-rolls Charge rolls.

leagues-of-votann.name: Sagitaur
leagues-of-votann.briefAbility: Grudge-maker Cannon: ranged attacks from this vehicle gain +1 to Wound rolls against the unit designated by Oaths of Kinship.

leagues-of-votann.name: Hekaton Land Fortress
leagues-of-votann.briefAbility: Ancestral Recall: once per battle, when this model would be destroyed, on a 4+ it instead retains 1 wound and continues fighting.

leagues-of-votann.name: Void Armour Brethren
leagues-of-votann.briefAbility: Gravitic Repulsion: this unit ignores the penalty for moving and firing Heavy weapons, and has a 5+ invulnerable save.

t-au-empire.name: Fire Warriors Strike Team
t-au-empire.briefAbility: For the Greater Good: this unit may fire its weapons at an enemy that charged a friendly unit within 6", even if it is not the closest target.

t-au-empire.name: Fire Warriors Breacher Team
t-au-empire.briefAbility: Pulse Blasters: Assault weapons that gain +1 Strength and AP at under half-range, devastating at point-blank.

t-au-empire.name: Commander in Coldstar Battlesuit
t-au-empire.briefAbility: For the Greater Good: this model can use its marker lights to improve Hit rolls for other T'au units targeting the same enemy.

t-au-empire.name: Crisis Battlesuits
t-au-empire.briefAbility: Multi-tracker: this unit can shoot its weapons at two different enemy units in the same Shooting Phase.

t-au-empire.name: Stealth Battlesuits
t-au-empire.briefAbility: Camo Field: this unit always counts as being in cover; enemies subtract 1 from Hit rolls when targeting it.

t-au-empire.name: Riptide
t-au-empire.briefAbility: Nova Reactor: once per battle, boost the Riptide's weapons profile for one Shooting Phase, increasing its shots or Damage.

t-au-empire.name: Kroot Carnivores
t-au-empire.briefAbility: Jungle Fighters: this unit counts as being in cover in any terrain feature; re-rolls Wound rolls in melee against Infantry.

t-au-empire.name: Hammerhead Gunship
t-au-empire.briefAbility: Railgun: incredibly high-powered main weapon that wounds on 2+ and deals D6+6 damage; on an unmodified Wound roll of 6, double the damage.

tyranids.name: Termagants
tyranids.briefAbility: Skulking Horrors: if this unit is entirely within 6" of a friendly Tervigon at the start of the Morale phase, it automatically passes Battleshock tests.

tyranids.name: Hormagaunts
tyranids.briefAbility: Bounding Leap: this unit can re-roll Advance rolls and Charge rolls; after destroying an enemy unit in melee, make a free 6" Normal Move.

tyranids.name: Hive Tyrant
tyranids.briefAbility: Synaptic Nexus: friendly Tyranid units within 12" re-roll Morale tests; Psyker power can be used to deal D3 mortal wounds to a visible enemy unit.

tyranids.name: Tyranid Warriors
tyranids.briefAbility: Synapse Creature: friendly Tyranid units within 6" of this unit are not required to take Battleshock tests.

tyranids.name: Genestealers
tyranids.briefAbility: Lightning Reflexes: this unit has a 5+ invulnerable save; always Fights First in the Fight Phase.

tyranids.name: Carnifex
tyranids.briefAbility: Living Battering Ram: this model re-rolls Charge rolls; when it charges, enemy units within Engagement Range suffer D3 mortal wounds.

tyranids.name: Tervigon
tyranids.briefAbility: Brood Progenitor: once per Command Phase, spawn D6+3 Termagants to join a nearby friendly unit or form a new unit.

tyranids.name: Neurogaunts
tyranids.briefAbility: Synaptic Relays: while within 6" of another Synapse unit, this unit re-rolls all failed Wound rolls in melee and cannot be Battle-shocked.
